original_idea.body:
# Importing Nuclear Non-Proliferation Export Control Logic to AI Dual-Use Licensing

**Problem:** AI dual-use governance lacks a coherent licensing framework. Nuclear export controls (IAEA safeguards, dual-use item lists) offer a tested model for controlling dangerous technology diffusion.

**Direction:** Map the structure of IAEA dual-use export control lists and licensing criteria onto AI capabilities. Produce a hypothetical 'AI dual-use capability list' with licensing tier criteria analogous to nuclear items. Identify where the analogy holds and where it breaks down for cybersecurity capabilities specifically.

**Why it matters:** Nuclear non-proliferation provides 70+ years of governance design knowledge. Systematic importation of this logic could accelerate AI dual-use governance maturity by decades.

**Relevant context:** Bengio et al. 2026 international governance; HACCA paper policy recommendations; EU AI Act systemic risk framework.
